record.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11761. Abstract summary: Despite the progress made by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in computational pathology, they remain limited by a predominant focus on patch-level analysis, missing essential contextual information at the whole-slide level. The lack of large-scale instruction datasets and the gigapixel scale of whole slide images (WSIs) Out of scope: Whole-slide pathology VLM dataset/assistant capability work, no serving efficiency claim.
record.title: SlideChat: A Large Vision-Language Assistant for Whole-Slide Pathology Image Understanding
